sections.content: HTML offers unordered lists (<ul>), ordered lists (<ol> with optional start/reversed), and tables for grid data.
Tables use <table>, <tr> rows, <th> header cells, and <td> data cells. Never use tables for page layout — CSS Grid/Flexbox does that.
Key points: <ol> numbers items automatically, nested lists go inside <li>, and tables need proper header cells for accessibility.
